meta.title: Silent Shout
meta.source_file: The Knife - Silent Shout (Official Music Video).mp3

interpretation.summary: A driving, four-on-the-floor electronic drum track that relentlessly builds in density and textural complexity, layering noisy shakers, syncopated metallic percussion, and various cymbals over a foundational techno kick drum.

vocabulary.timbre: A synthetic drum kit composed of a punchy, low-frequency kick, crisp digital hi-hats and shakers, and an array of resonant, metallic, and atonal percussive sounds. The high harmonic ratio suggests significant tonal components within the percussive hits.
vocabulary.brightness: Moderately bright and persistent, with a constant high-frequency sizzle from 16th-note shakers layered over a deep, thudding kick. The overall texture is sharp and digital, with the spectral energy centered in the low-mids and high-treble regions.
vocabulary.envelope: Dominated by extremely short, percussive envelopes. The kick has a sharp attack and quick decay. Hats and shakers are tiny transient clicks. Some metallic and cymbal sounds introduce longer, resonant decays and releases, adding a sense of space and complexity as the track builds.
vocabulary.register_density: The track starts sparsely with a low-register kick, but rapidly builds into a dense, full-spectrum arrangement. The groove is anchored by the low kick and high-register shakers/hats, while syncopated mid-register metallic sounds fill the spaces, creating a dense rhythmic wall.
vocabulary.harmony_mode: Primarily rhythmic and unpitched. However, several percussive elements (cymbals, clanks) have a distinct metallic pitch, often creating dissonant, tense intervals that contribute to the track's dark, industrial atmosphere, aligning with the A# minor tonality.
vocabulary.groove: A rigid, machine-like, and driving 4/4 techno groove. A four-to-the-floor kick provides a relentless pulse, with 16th-note shakers creating a fast, nervous energy. Syncopation is introduced through layered, off-kilter metallic percussion patterns.
vocabulary.space_grit: The production is generally dry and upfront, particularly the core kick and hat elements. As layers are added, a digital reverb with a noticeable decay is introduced on cymbals and certain percussive hits, opening up the space. A subtle layer of digital saturation and bit-reduction-like grit is present on many sounds, giving the track a sharp, aggressive edge.

tracks.name: Techno Kick
tracks.pattern: Four-on-the-floor quarter notes.
tracks.description: The foundational kick drum that drives the track from the beginning. It's punchy, deep, and consistent.

tracks.name: Shaker Pulse
tracks.pattern: Constant 16th notes.
tracks.description: A high-frequency noise shaker that enters early and provides a constant layer of rhythmic energy and tension. It's filtered to be very bright and sharp.

tracks.name: Offbeat Hat
tracks.pattern: Eighth notes on the off-beats.
tracks.description: A classic, sharp closed hi-hat sound that locks in with the kick to create the core groove.

tracks.name: Syncopated Clank
tracks.pattern: A syncopated 1-bar pattern that emphasizes upbeats.
tracks.description: A metallic, resonant percussion sound that enters around 0:14, adding a signature syncopated layer to the main groove.

tracks.name: Ride Cymbal
tracks.pattern: Quarter notes, sometimes with a preceding 16th note pickup.
tracks.description: A washy, metallic ride cymbal sound that appears in later, more intense sections (e.g., around 1:37), adding a bright, driving layer on top of the existing percussion.

tracks.name: Glitch Perc
tracks.pattern: A sparse, irregular syncopated pattern.
tracks.description: A distorted, aggressive, and complex percussive sound that adds an industrial, glitchy texture. It appears intermittently to add variation and intensity.

interpretation.summary: A heavily processed and pitch-shifted monophonic vocal performance that acts as the track's central melodic and narrative element. The sound is transformed into a robotic, synthetic baritone, with significant digital artifacts, distortion, and a tense, driving rhythmic character.

vocabulary.timbre: Nasal, robotic, and heavily processed, resembling a pitch-shifted vocoder or a pulse wave passed through a formant filter. The core sound is tonal but rich with digital grit and complex overtones.
vocabulary.brightness: Bright and cutting, with a high spectral centroid. The sound has significant high-frequency content generated by the distortion and digital pitch-shifting processes, allowing it to slice through a mix.
vocabulary.envelope: Plosive and articulated, with a very fast attack on each syllable and a controlled decay, likely shaped by heavy compression. The release is short but noticeable, with reverb tails.
vocabulary.register_density: A single, monophonic vocal line occupying a synthetic baritone range (approx. G2-A4). The density is low, focusing all attention on the one melodic voice.
vocabulary.harmony_mode: The melody is firmly rooted in D Aeolian (natural minor), reinforcing the track's dark and brooding atmosphere. The melodic contours clearly outline the D minor scale and its characteristic intervals.
vocabulary.groove: Highly syncopated and rhythmically precise. Phrases often begin on upbeats and push against the underlying pulse, giving the vocal a forward, driving momentum that functions almost percussively.
vocabulary.space_grit: The sound is defined by heavy digital grit and saturation, with audible aliasing artifacts from the aggressive pitch-shifting. It sits in a moderately sized space, treated with a noticeable but not overwhelming reverb.

tracks.name: RoboVocal Lead
tracks.pattern: A syncopated, evolving melodic line following the main vocal performance. Phrases are typically 2-4 bars long and are rhythmically active, using a mixture of eighth and sixteenth notes.
tracks.description: The sole instrument in this stem, this processed vocal carries the lyrics and primary melody throughout the entire track. Its sound is defined by aggressive pitch-shifting, distortion, and a controlled reverb.

interpretation.score_draft: SPECULATIVE STARTER: The core of this sound is a heavily processed vocal, best approximated by a synth that can create complex, metallic timbres. Try an FMSynth. Set `harmonicity` to a non-integer like 1.5 and `modulationIndex` high (10-20) to generate a rich, gritty spectrum. The envelope needs to be sharp: `attack: 0.01`, `decay: 0.1`, `sustain: 0.9`, `release: 0.4`. Crucially, add significant distortion using `drive: 0.6` or a separate `Distortion` effect. Shape the result with a `lowpass` filter around 4000Hz with some resonance (`filterQ: 2`). The melody is in D minor, using syncopated rhythms. A sample one-bar phrase could be: `['', 'D4', '', 'D4', 'F4', '', 'G4', 'A4', '', 'G4', '', 'F4', '', '', '', '']` on a '16n' grid. Add `Reverb` (0.4) and a touch of `Chorus` (0.2) for space and width.

interpretation.summary: A dense, driving, and hypnotic arrangement of multiple interlocking synth arpeggios, creating a complex rhythmic and harmonic texture over a simple four-on-the-floor synth pulse.

vocabulary.timbre: Digital, arpeggiated, and layered; sounds range from clean, plucky FM tones to brighter, detuned sawtooth waves.
vocabulary.brightness: Bright and articulate, centered in the mid-to-high frequencies, with the constant motion of the arpeggios creating a shimmering top end.
vocabulary.envelope: Predominantly short and plucky (fast attack, quick decay, low sustain), characteristic of sequencer-driven synth lines.
vocabulary.register_density: Very dense and busy. A continuous, machine-like flurry of 16th notes primarily in the mid and high registers.
vocabulary.harmony_mode: Tense and hypnotic, centered on A minor. Harmony is implied through the rapid cycling of notes within minor chord structures.
vocabulary.groove: Strictly quantized, mechanical, and propulsive, based on a relentless 16th-note grid with no swing.
vocabulary.space_grit: Sounds are individually clean but placed in a large, ambient space via reverb. Grit is minimal, manifesting as a sharp, digital edge rather than analog distortion.

tracks.name: Kick Synth
tracks.pattern: A simple four-on-the-floor pulse on the root note.
tracks.description: Provides the foundational pulse from the very beginning of the track, acting as a soft, tonal kick drum. It underpins the more complex layers that enter later.

tracks.name: Main Arp
tracks.pattern: A continuous 16th-note arpeggio outlining the primary chords.
tracks.description: The core rhythmic and harmonic engine of the piece, entering after the intro at 22.8s. Its clean, plucky sound and constant motion create the main hypnotic texture.

interpretation.score_draft: SPECULATIVE STARTER: The core of this sound is layering multiple arpeggiators and sequences with distinct timbres. Start with a simple 'Kick Synth' using a `Synth({oscillator: {type: 'sine'}, envelope: {decay: 0.3}})` on a '4n' grid for the pulse. The main texture comes from several `Tone.Sequence` instances running at '16n'. Layer 1: An `FMSynth({harmonicity: 3, modulationIndex: 10})` playing a simple arpeggio like `['A3', 'C4', 'E4', 'C4']`. Layer 2: A detuned `PolySynth({oscillator: {type: 'fatsawtooth', count: 4, spread: 30}})` playing a counter-pattern. Layer 3: A high-frequency 'gated pad' effect using a `PolySynth` with a very short envelope (`envelope: {attack: 0.01, decay: 0.1, sustain: 0}`) playing repeated high chords like 'A5+C6+E6'. Route all synths to a shared `Reverb` with a decay around 2.5s and use `AutoPanner` on the arpeggiator tracks to create stereo movement and width.

interpretation.summary: A deep, driving, four-on-the-floor bass line that functions as the track's primary rhythmic and harmonic anchor. It's built from a single synth patch that blends the percussive attack of a kick drum with the sustained low-frequency tone of a sub-bass. The pattern is relentlessly steady, with the root note shifting subtly over long, multi-bar phrases.

vocabulary.timbre: Deep, round, and fundamental-heavy, resembling a hybrid of a sine-wave sub and a soft 808-style kick. The high harmonic ratio (0.92) confirms its strong tonal character, but the very low spectral rolloff (213 Hz) keeps it focused in the sub-bass region.
vocabulary.brightness: Extremely dark and low-frequency focused. The mean spectral centroid of 249 Hz indicates that almost all energy resides below the low-mids, creating a sound that is often felt more than heard on smaller playback systems.
vocabulary.envelope: Very percussive and plucky. It features a nearly instantaneous attack, a very fast decay, and zero sustain, creating a distinct, separated pulse on each quarter note rather than a continuous drone.
vocabulary.register_density: Consistently in the very low bass register (E1-E2). The density is sparse and constant, playing a single monophonic note on every quarter note without variation in rhythm.
vocabulary.harmony_mode: The bass outlines a simple, modal root motion, grounding the harmony in D# minor. It avoids complex harmonic function, instead creating a hypnotic, trance-like foundation by slowly shifting between key diatonic notes like the tonic (D#) and subdominant (G#) over many bars.
vocabulary.groove: A rigid, motorik four-on-the-floor quarter-note pulse at a brisk 172 BPM. The groove is completely straight, with no swing or syncopation, providing a powerful and unwavering rhythmic drive.
vocabulary.space_grit: The sound is exceptionally clean and dry, with no audible reverb, delay, or significant distortion. The 'grit' is more of a physical pressure from the low frequencies rather than textural noise. The low spectral flatness (0.02) confirms its tonal purity.

tracks.name: Sub Kick Bass
tracks.pattern: A relentless four-on-the-floor quarter-note pulse. The pitch shifts slowly, typically holding one note for 4, 8, or 16 bars before moving to another note within the D# minor scale.
tracks.description: This is the sole instrument in this stem, acting as both the kick drum and the bass line. It starts at 0:00 and plays continuously throughout the entire track, providing the fundamental pulse and harmonic foundation.
